profile.visual_desc: Heavy olive-drab bipedal robot with thick armor plating. Features a blue fabric loincloth and exposed mechanical cabling at the joints.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic mechanical profile with a large blue circular optical sensor and a secondary green lens set in weathered grey metal.
profile.weapon_desc: Heavy integrated energy cannon on the left arm.
profile.step1_ready: Standing isometric stance, facing down-right. The arm cannon is lowered and deactivated.
profile.step2_windup: The robot raises its left arm horizontally. The mechanical muzzle tip opens to reveal a glowing yellow core.
profile.step3_impact: A long, solid horizontal beam of orange energy fires from the cannon toward the right.
profile.step4_finish: The unit maintains its aim as the energy beam fades. The muzzle remains open in a cooling phase.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The horizontal energy beam in Frame 4 aligns precisely with the forward-pointing axis of the arm cannon.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation aligns with reference. Posing and beam alignment are consistent across the sequence.
